description:
Spec: draft-atwood-jmap-cid-00 §2 (capability URI urn:ietf:params:jmap:cid).

## Acceptance

- jmap-base-client Session adds (probably via SessionExt or directly on Session): `fn supports_cid(&self) -> bool` — returns true iff the session capabilities map has urn:ietf:params:jmap:cid as a key
- The presence of the URI is sufficient (the capability value object is empty per spec §2 — "no capability fields defined at this time")
- Add adjacent rustdoc cross-referencing the existing supports_quotas, supports_refplus pattern (chat-client/session.rs:supports_quotas is the precedent)
- Test: a synthesised Session with the URI key returns true; without it returns false

## Out of scope

- Acting on the capability (Blob/upload sha256 field is D.3; FileNode sha256 is deferred)
- Negotiating a stricter mode (servers either advertise or don't)
title: Layer D: Add supports_cid() helper on Session in jmap-base-client
